issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 07 (solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql) does not include a join condition linking Gemeinde and Schwimmbad. As written, the query SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde, Schwimmbad WHERE Schwimmbad.art='Freibad' produces a Cartesian product between all Gemeinden and Freibäder instead of pairing each Freibad with its actual Gemeinde. This contradicts the problem statement which requests the names of Gemeinden that have a Freibad and the names of the respective Freibäder, and it is inconsistent with the join patterns used in other solution queries.
issues.suggestedFix: Add the join condition to associate each Schwimmbad with its Gemeinde. For example: SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde JOIN Schwimmbad ON Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel WHERE Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad'; This yields the intended pairs of Gemeinde and Freibad names.
